cards.card_text: Some Kohathites, a Levite clan, prepare the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
cards.verse_text: Some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
cards.snippet: …of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.

cards.card_text: Then the job list gets to the bread: the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering and the wafers of unleavened bread.
cards.verse_text: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
cards.snippet: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread,…

cards.card_text: Along with the showbread, the fine flour and the wafers, what else does the job list give the Levites?
cards.verse_text: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
cards.snippet: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread,…

cards.card_text: It's dedicated to the LORD, for burning fragrant incense before Him and for setting out the showbread continuously.
cards.verse_text: Behold, I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts of the LORD our God.
cards.snippet: …dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well…

cards.card_text: Abijah says they set out the rows of showbread, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand.
cards.verse_text: They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand.
cards.snippet: They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps…

cards.card_text: Then they report to King Hezekiah that the entire house of the LORD is cleansed, right down to the altar of burnt offering and the table of the showbread.
cards.verse_text: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported, “We have cleansed the entire house of the LORD, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the showbread with all its utensils.
cards.snippet: …of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the showbread with all its utensils.
